findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 稱公司銷售不實質依賴單一客戶或少數客戶群，信用條款設計以降低單一客戶信用集中。
findings.excerpt: The Company's sales are not materially dependent on a single customer or a small group of customers.

findings.claim: Q1 2026 10-Q 揭露 Fitch 於 2026-03-06 將信用評等展望由 watch negative 調為 stable；本次搜尋未見 2026 年主要評等機構降級。
findings.excerpt: On March 6, 2026, Fitch revised their credit rating outlook from watch negative to stable.

note: 未搜尋到前幾大客戶占營收比重的具體百分比；公司自述無重大客戶依賴。Moody's/S&P 2026 動作未查到。
